newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore share sentiment seen cautious.
newsitem.headline: Singapore share sentiment seen cautious.

text.p: Singapore share sentiment was likely to be cautious on Friday with further fallout from the Thai baht crisis expected to combine with weaker Singapore GDP figures to leave investors uninspired, dealers said.
"I think there's too much downside for big buyers at the moment," one dealer at a local firm said.

The Straits Times Industrials Index slid 28.52 points to end at 2,069.74 on Thursday as sell programmes took control of the market with fund managers adjusting exposures in the wake of regional efforts to prop up the struggling Thai baht.
Singapore on Friday reported falls in productivity, manufacturing and electronics for the first quarter of 1997 and slower growth across the entire economy.
One brighter signal came from the United States after shares rose to a new record high on Thursday on Wall Street, boosted by lower than expected inflation data for April.
